description: Held-out ticket continuations whose verified account ids take each shape account creation produces: plain name-derived ids, a numeric suffix for a taken id, and generated digit-heavy ids for service or lab accounts. Each case renders the verified-account message the live worker sends; a proposal passes only with the bound project and a summary naming the verified user_id or email. Names, ids, projects and request texts are absent from training (enforced by a unit test).

cases.name: ids plain name live wording
cases.user: Create a corporate account for given name Farah, family name Qureshi, department Treasury and role Auditor. After the account is successfully created, create a Jira ticket in project HRD for that created account, then notify me by email.

cases.user: Onboard Bruno Alves as Courier in Logistics: create their directory account first, then raise a Jira issue in FAC about it.
